title_zh: 与幼儿呼吸道病原体相关的症状:2019-2025 年。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Acute respiratory illnesses (ARI) are common in early life and cause a range of respiratory symptoms. We describe symptomology profiles and medical outcomes attributable to respiratory tract infection episodes. METHODS: Weekly mid-turbinate nasal swabs and biweekly symptom surveys were collected from November 2019 to August 2025 from a longitudinal birth cohort of healthy US infants and children in Cincinnati, Ohio. Nasal swabs were tested for pathogen targets on the Luminex NxTAG Respiratory Pathogen Panel and the Flu SC2 assay. Pathogen-specific infections were linked to the temporally-corresponding symptom surveys. Co-infections were removed to observe only independent pathogen symptomologies. RESULTS: We captured 15 898 ARIs from 1223 unique children. Compared with older children, infants were more likely to experience respiratory distress/dyspnea with influenza A (odds ratio [OR] = 4.73), respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) A (OR = 2.52), RSV B (OR = 2.22), human metapneumovirus (OR = 2.36), and SARS-CoV-2 (OR = 3.99) (all P < 0.01) but not influenza B (P = 0.36) or parainfluenza (P = 0.10). Hospital and emergency department medical attention was similarly associated. Influenza A had greater odds of fever (OR = 2.77, P = 0.01) and anorexia (OR = 2.94, P = 0.01) compared with influenza B. Asymptomatic infections were frequent. Over three-quarters of symptomatic episodes were treated at home. Vomiting and/or diarrhea occurred during one-quarter of RSV and one-third of influenza infection episodes. CONCLUSIONS: Our results highlight extraordinary variability in respiratory tract infection symptoms and outcomes in a US cohort of healthy children. Understanding why some young children suffer severe symptoms and others remain relatively unscathed could unlock actionable opportunities to improve child health. Furthermore, we observed frequent diarrhea and/or vomiting during respiratory tract infections and nuanced differences between influenza A and B symptoms.
abstract_zh: 背景和目标:急性呼吸道疾病(ARI)在生命早期很常见,会引起一系列呼吸道症状。我们描述了呼吸道感染发作的症状特征和医疗结果。方法:从 2019 年 11 月至 2025 年 8 月,对俄亥俄州辛辛那提健康美国婴儿和儿童的纵向出生 队列研究 进行每周中鼻甲鼻拭子采集和每两周一次的症状调查。在 Luminex NxTAG 呼吸道病原体面板和 Flu SC2 检测中对鼻拭子进行病原体靶标检测。病原体特异性感染与时间相应的症状调查相关。去除共感染以仅观察独立的病原体症状。结果:我们从 1223 名独特儿童中捕获了 15 898 个 ARI。与年龄较大的儿童相比,婴儿更容易因甲型流感(比值比 [OR] = 4.73)、呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) A (OR = 2.52)、RSV B (OR = 2.22)、人类偏肺病毒 (OR = 2.36) 和 SARS-CoV-2 (OR = 3.99) 出现呼吸窘迫/呼吸困难(所有 P < 0.01)但不是乙型流感(P = 0.36)或副流感(P = 0.10)。医院和急诊科的医疗护理也有类似的相关性。与乙型流感相比,甲型流感出现发烧(OR = 2.77,P = 0.01)和厌食(OR = 2.94,P = 0.01)的几率更大。无症状感染很常见。超过四分之三的症状发作是在家治疗的。四分之一的 RSV 感染和三分之一的流感感染发作期间发生呕吐和/或腹泻。结论:我们的结果强调了美国 队列研究 健康儿童呼吸道感染症状和结果的显着差异。了解为什么一些幼儿会出现严重症状,而另一些则相对未受影响,可以为改善儿童健康提供可行的机会。此外,我们观察到呼吸道感染期间频繁腹泻和/或呕吐,以及甲型和乙型流感症状之间的细微差别。

title: An evaluation of the anti-human respiratory syncytial virus activity of sophora alkaloids and the enhanced efficacy by liposomes via intratracheal administration
abstract: Human respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a major cause of severe lower respiratory tract infections and related deaths in infants, young children, and the elderly. The clinical management of RSV is challenging due to its high mutation rate and the limited efficacy and safety of existing antiviral drugs. Sophora alkaloids, natural compounds derived from Sophora flavescens, exhibit broad-spectrum antiviral and immunomodulatory activities. Mechanistically, RSV relies on ERK1/2 phosphorylation to facilitate viral replication and spread, while sophora alkaloids inhibit ERK1/2 phosphorylation via regulating MEK/ERK signaling pathway, thereby suppressing viral proliferation and the inflammatory response caused by RSV infection. In vivo studies demonstrated that sophora alkaloids significantly reduced the mortality of RSV-infected mice via intratracheal administration. To further enhance the pulmonary retention of drugs, liposomes were used to improve the therapeutic effects of sophora alkaloids. As the most effective sophora alkaloids against RSV infection, sophocarpine (SC) was encapsulated in liposomes to enhance its anti-RSV infection effect. In vivo studies demonstrate that SC-loaded liposomes outperformed the free SC in suppressing RSV replication and alleviating pulmonary inflammation in murine models of RSV infection. This study not only clarifies the mechanism by which sophora alkaloids counteract RSV-infection but also provides liposomal formulation of SC to improve the anti-RSV therapeutic effects.

abstract_zh: 人类 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 是婴儿、幼儿和老年人严重下呼吸道感染和相关死亡的主要原因。由于 RSV 的高 突变 发生率以及现有 抗病毒药物 药物的疗效和安全性有限,RSV 的临床管理具有挑战性。苦参生物碱是从苦参中提取的天然化合物,具有广谱 抗病毒药物 和免疫调节活性。从机制上讲,RSV依赖ERK1/2磷酸化来促进病毒复制和传播,而槐花生物碱通过调节MEK/ERK信号通路抑制ERK1/2磷酸化,从而抑制病毒增殖和RSV感染引起的炎症反应。体内研究表明,槐花生物碱通过气管内给药可显着降低 RSV 感染小鼠的 死亡率。为了进一步增强药物的肺滞留,采用脂质体来提高苦参生物碱的治疗效果。槐果碱(SC)作为抗RSV感染最有效的生物碱,将其封装在脂质体中以增强其抗RSV感染的效果。体内研究表明,在 RSV 感染的小鼠模型中,负载 SC 的脂质体在抑制 RSV 复制和减轻肺部炎症方面优于游离 SC。本研究不仅阐明了槐花生物碱抗RSV感染的机制,而且提供了SC的脂质体制剂,以提高抗RSV的治疗效果。

title: Divergent Nasal Immune Responses of HRV VS RSV Infection in Childhood Asthma
abstract: HRV and RSV are the two most common viruses that trigger asthma attacks in children, yet how they affect the nasal immune system in different ways is still not fully clear. This study used RNA-seq data (GSE115770) to compare nasal gene expression between asthmatic children infected with HRV (n=129) and those with RSV (n=7). HRV infection changed 2,822 genes, mainly activating antiviral responses (such as IFIT1, IRF7, CXCL10) and attracting neutrophils. In contrast, RSV altered over 21,000 genes, strongly activating Th2/IL-33 related genes (IL1B, CSF3R) and the NF-κB pathway. By comparing virus-specific genes, the study found clear differences: HRV-specific genes linked to immune regulation, MAPK signaling and miRNA-related gene control; RSV-specific genes were tied to typical immune reactions like adaptive immunity, virus defense and MAPK pathways. establishes a random forest model to accurately distinguish between HRV or RSV infected children and non infected children (AUC of HRV=0.952, AUC of RSV=1.000). These results indicate that HRV and RSV elicit different immune responses in children's noses and provide genetic markers that may help identify which virus is causing asthma attacks.

title: Nirsevimab and Hospitalization for Lower Respiratory Tract Infection During the Second Season.
abstract: OBJECTIVES: To assess the effect of nirsevimab in preventing hospitalizations for lower respiratory tract infection (LRTI) during the second respiratory season of life among infants who were administered nirsevimab in their first months of life. METHODS: Community-based case-control study conducted in 9 tertiary pediatric hospitals in Andalusia, Southern Spain. Infants born between April 1, 2023, and March 31, 2024, were included. Cases were infants hospitalized for LRTI during the 2024 to 2025 season. For each case, 4 community controls were matched by birthdate and province. Exposure was nirsevimab administration during the 2023 to 2024 respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) season. The main outcome was hospitalization for LRTI during the 2024 to 2025 season. Inverse probability weighting (IPW) and doubly robust augmented IPW (AIPW) models were used to estimate the average treatment effect, expressed as absolute risk reduction (ARR). RESULTS: The study included 1375 infants (275 cases and 1100 controls). Nirsevimab administration during the 2023 to 2024 season was associated with a 17.0% ARR (95% CI, 3.2%-30.8%) in LRTI hospitalizations during the 2024 to 2025 season in the AIPW model. Stronger associations were observed among RSV-positive cases (ARR = 25.4%; 95% CI, 4.9%-45.8%) and in infants with a history of inhaler use (ARR = 27.7%; 95% CI, 6.4%-48.9%). A negative control exposure (rotavirus vaccination) showed no association, supporting no evidence of relevant residual confounding regarding health-seeking behaviors. CONCLUSIONS: Nirsevimab administration was associated with a reduction in second-season LRTI hospitalizations, suggesting meaningful benefits beyond the season of administration and potential implications for future cost-effectiveness evaluations.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 尼塞韦单抗 给药与第二季 LRTI 住院治疗的减少有关,这表明在给药季节之后具有有意义的益处,并对未来的成本效益评估具有潜在影响。

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等;虽然该研究使用了稳健的统计方法和阴性对照来解决混杂问题,但观察设计仍可能引入无法测量的偏差,并且研究人群之外的普遍性尚不确定。

title: Influenza, COVID-19, and RSV Vaccinations for Immunocompromised Children and Household Contacts.
abstract: Immunocompromised pediatric patients, including hematopoietic cell and solid organ transplant recipients, those undergoing chemotherapy for malignancy, and those receiving biologic response modifiers for autoimmune or inflammatory conditions, are at risk for severe disease from vaccine-preventable respiratory viral infections such as influenza, SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19), and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). These children face higher rates of hospitalization, intensive care admissions, and mortality, reflecting contributions from an immature immune system, absence of immunologic memory, and/or increased environmental exposures. Immunization recommendations for immunocompromised children are largely extrapolated from studies conducted among healthy children and/or immunocompromised adults due to a paucity of primary data on immunological responses and vaccine efficacy in immunocompromised children. Trends in vaccine hesitancy in the general population, ongoing transmission of respiratory viral infections in the community, and suboptimal vaccination rates among immunocompromised children and their household contacts further compound the risk for this vulnerable population. As the number of children with immunocompromising conditions expands, it is imperative that primary care practitioners and subspecialists who care for immunocompromised children ensure appropriate immunizations are provided to these patients and their household and community contacts. We will review available data supporting the current guidelines regarding vaccine dosing, scheduling, and formulations to prevent influenza, COVID-19, and RSV infections in immunocompromised children. Furthermore, we highlight key knowledge gaps and areas of current investigation aimed at improving respiratory viral vaccine immunogenicity and optimize protection.

abstract_zh: 免疫功能低下的儿科患者,包括造血细胞和实体器官移植受者、接受恶性肿瘤化疗的患者以及接受针对自身免疫或炎症状况的生物反应调节剂的患者,有因 疫苗 可预防的呼吸道病毒感染(如流感、SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) 和 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV))而患上严重疾病的风险。这些儿童面临更高的住院率、重症监护率和 死亡率 率,反映出免疫系统不成熟、免疫记忆缺失和/或环境暴露增加的影响。由于缺乏免疫反应和 疫苗 在免疫功能低下儿童中的疗效的主要数据,针对免疫功能低下儿童的免疫建议很大程度上是从健康儿童和/或免疫功能低下成人中进行的研究推断出来的。普通人群对 疫苗 犹豫的趋势、社区呼吸道病毒感染持续存在的 传播 以及免疫功能低下儿童及其家庭接触者中 疫苗接种 率不理想的情况进一步加剧了这一弱势群体的风险。随着患有免疫功能低下的儿童数量的增加,护理免疫功能低下儿童的初级保健从业者和专科医生必须确保为这些患者及其家庭和社区接触者提供适当的免疫接种。我们将审查支持当前关于 疫苗 剂量、时间安排和配方的指南的可用数据,以预防免疫功能低下儿童的流感、COVID-19 和 RSV 感染。此外,我们强调了关键知识差距和当前研究领域,旨在提高呼吸道病毒 疫苗 免疫原性和优化保护。

title: Utilizing Virtual Clinical Trials to Inform Target Coverage That Drives RSV Antiviral Efficacy.
abstract: ABSTRACT Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection can result in a range of disease severity from mild upper respiratory tract symptoms to lower respiratory tract illness, with clinical manifestations dependent on age, co‐morbidities, and immune status. At present, there is no antiviral approved for adults with RSV disease, and only one treatment option with limited utilization is available for pediatric patients. While several RSV antiviral candidates have demonstrated virological efficacy in healthy adult challenge studies, to date they have subsequently failed to show efficacy in patients. Mechanistically understanding the translation of efficacy from preclinical to challenge to patient studies is essential in addressing this unmet medical need in children and adults with RSV disease. This work uses a quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP) approach to mathematically represent the underlying pathophysiology of RSV infection to simulate and predict the effects of investigational direct acting RSV antiviral therapeutics. We developed virtual populations that capture viral load dynamics in viral challenge studies, where the participants are healthy adult volunteers, upon treatment with the F‐protein inhibitor sisunatovir and the N‐protein inhibitor zelicapavir. Due to underlying differences in dynamics between key populations, we also developed a pediatric patient virtual population to match the results from the zelicapavir pediatric Phase 2 study. This work projects that for a minimum coverage > 1× free EC 90 at C min , a treatment window of 5 to 7 days post‐symptom onset is feasible for observing virological efficacy in pediatric patients and may lead to potential success in a phase 3 pivotal RSV antiviral drug trial.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the unmet medical need for effective RSV antivirals in children and adults by investigating why RSV antiviral candidates have shown efficacy in healthy adult challenge studies but failed in patients.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This research used a quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP) approach to develop virtual populations representing viral load dynamics in healthy adult volunteers and pediatric patients treated with RSV antivirals sisunatovir and zelicapavir.
analysis.methods: The study employed mathematical modeling to simulate RSV pathophysiology and predict the effects of investigational direct-acting RSV antivirals, including virtual populations matching pediatric Phase 2 study results.
analysis.main_results: The analysis projects that a minimum coverage > 1× free EC90 at Cmin and a treatment window of 5 to 7 days post-symptom onset may lead to potential success in a phase 3 pivotal RSV antiviral trial in pediatric patients.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that mechanistically understanding the translation of efficacy from preclinical to challenge to patient studies is essential, and this QSP approach provides a novel framework to predict antiviral efficacy.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform optimal treatment timing and coverage for RSV antivirals, potentially guiding the design of successful phase 3 trials and future therapeutic strategies for RSV disease.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate as the study relies on computational modeling and virtual populations rather than clinical trial data, though the approach provides mechanistic insights into RSV antiviral efficacy.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the critical gap in RSV antiviral development by using quantitative systems pharmacology to model why candidates succeed in healthy adults but fail in patients. The researchers developed virtual populations for both healthy adults and pediatric patients treated with sisunatovir and zelicapavir, projecting that a minimum coverage > 1× free EC90 at Cmin and a 5-7 day treatment window post-symptom onset could enable successful phase 3 trials in children. This computational approach provides novel insights into RSV pathophysiology and antiviral mechanisms, offering a framework to optimize future therapeutic strategies for RSV disease in both pediatric and adult populations.

title: Effectiveness of RSV Prevention Strategies in US Infants: 2024-2025.
abstract: OBJECTIVE: In 2023, 2 products, a long-acting monoclonal antibody (nirsevimab) and maternal respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccination, were recommended in the United States to prevent severe RSV disease among infants in their first RSV season. Low uptake during the 2023 to 2024 RSV season limited effectiveness estimates. We estimated nirsevimab and maternal RSV vaccine effectiveness against RSV-associated emergency department (ED) encounters and hospitalization among US infants during the 2024 to 2025 RSV season, when uptake was higher. METHODS: We used electronic health record data from 5 health care systems in test-negative analyses of ED encounters and hospitalizations with RSV-like illness during October 1, 2024 to March 31, 2025, among infants in their first RSV season. analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of RSV prevention strategies, specifically nirsevimab and maternal RSV vaccination, in reducing RSV-associated emergency department encounters and hospitalizations among US infants during their first RSV season.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used electronic health record data from 5 healthcare systems to analyze RSV-like illness cases among infants in their first RSV season during October 1, 2024 to March 31, 2025. It included 3531 ED encounters and 470 hospitalizations for nirsevimab analyses, and 810 ED encounters and 187 hospitalizations for maternal RSV vaccine analyses.
analysis.methods: Effectiveness was estimated using test-negative analyses, comparing RSV-positive with RSV-negative encounters based on immunization status. Logistic regression models were adjusted for age, race and ethnicity, sex, calendar day, and geographic region.
analysis.main_results: Nirsevimab effectiveness against RSV-associated ED encounters was 62% (95% CI: 54-68) and against hospitalization was 77% (95% CI: 61-87). Maternal RSV vaccine effectiveness against ED encounters was 49% (95% CI: 26-65) and against hospitalization was 82% (95% CI: 54-93).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these results as evidence of the effectiveness of both nirsevimab and maternal RSV vaccination in preventing RSV-associated ED encounters and hospitalizations among infants in their first RSV season.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings inform the importance of monitoring immunization effectiveness as uptake increases and additional RSV prevention products are recommended for public health strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on electronic health record data and potential biases in test-negative analyses. However, the evidence is strong given the large sample size and adjustment for key demographic and temporal factors.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the effectiveness of nirsevimab and maternal RSV vaccination in preventing RSV-associated emergency department encounters and hospitalizations among US infants during their first RSV season. Using electronic health record data from 5 healthcare systems, the researchers conducted test-negative analyses comparing RSV-positive with RSV-negative cases. They found that nirsevimab was effective against ED encounters (62%) and hospitalizations (77%), while maternal RSV vaccination showed effectiveness against ED encounters (49%) and hospitalizations (82%). The authors concluded that both interventions are effective, emphasizing the importance of monitoring their effectiveness as uptake increases. The study's reliance on electronic health records and potential biases in test-negative analyses are limitations, but the large sample size and adjustments for key factors support the strength of the findings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估 RSV 预防策略(特别是 尼塞韦单抗 和母体 RSV 疫苗接种)在减少美国婴儿在第一个 RSV 季节期间与 RSV 相关的急诊室就诊和住院治疗方面的有效性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用来自 5 个医疗保健系统的电子健康记录数据来分析 2024 年 10 月 1 日至 2025 年 3 月 31 日期间第一个 RSV 季节婴儿中的 RSV 类疾病病例。尼塞韦单抗 分析包括 3531 例急诊就诊和 470 例住院治疗,以及孕产妇 RSV 疫苗 分析的 810 例急诊就诊和 187 例住院治疗。
elements_zh.methods: 使用测试阴性分析评估有效性,根据免疫状态比较 RSV 阳性和 RSV 阴性情况。逻辑回归模型根据年龄、种族和民族、性别、日历日和地理区域进行了调整。
elements_zh.main_results: 尼塞韦单抗 针对 RSV 相关 ED 就诊的有效性为 62%(95% CI:54-68),针对住院治疗的有效性为 77%(95% CI:61-87)。母亲 RSV 疫苗 对抗 ED 的有效性为 49% (95% CI: 26-65),对抗住院治疗的有效性为 82% (95% CI: 54-93)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些结果解释为 尼塞韦单抗 和母体 RSV 疫苗接种 在预防婴儿第一个 RSV 季节中与 RSV 相关的 ED 遭遇和住院治疗方面的有效性的证据。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,随着接种率的增加,监测免疫有效性的重要性,并建议将额外的 RSV 预防产品用于公共卫生策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其对电子健康记录数据的依赖以及测试阴性分析中的潜在偏差而受到限制。然而,考虑到样本量大以及对关键人口和时间因素的调整,证据是强有力的。

abstract_zh: 目标:2023年,美国推荐长效单克隆抗体(尼塞韦单抗)和母体呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)疫苗接种这2种产品在婴儿第一个RSV季节预防严重RSV疾病。2023 年至 2024 年 RSV 季节期间使用率较低,限制了有效性估计。我们估计了 2024 年至 2025 年 RSV 季节期间,尼塞韦单抗 和母体 RSV 疫苗 对美国婴儿与 RSV 相关的急诊室 (ED) 接触和住院治疗的有效性,当时的摄入量较高。方法:我们使用来自 5 个医疗保健系统的电子健康记录数据,对 2024 年 10 月 1 日至 2025 年 3 月 31 日期间,在第一个 RSV 季节的婴儿中,对 ED 遭遇和因 RSV 样疾病住院的情况进行测试阴性分析。尼塞韦单抗 和母亲 RSV 疫苗 的有效性是通过比较 RSV 阳性和 RSV 阴性的情况来估计的,这些情况是在单独的逻辑回归模型中针对年龄、种族和民族、性别、日历日和地理区域进行调整后的免疫状态。结果:在 尼塞韦单抗 分析中纳入的 3531 例急诊就诊和 470 例住院治疗中,尼塞韦单抗 针对 RSV 相关急诊就诊和住院的有效性分别为 62%(95% CI:54-68)和 77%(95% CI:61-87)。在母体 RSV 疫苗 分析中纳入的 810 例 ED 就诊和 187 例住院治疗中,疫苗 针对 RSV 相关 ED 就诊和住院的有效性分别为 49% (95% CI: 26-65) 和 82% (95% CI: 54-93)。结论:尼塞韦单抗 和母体 RSV 疫苗接种 对于第一个 RSV 季节婴儿中与 RSV 相关的 ED 事件和住院治疗有效。随着吸收量的增加和其他产品的推荐,监测婴儿 RSV 免疫效果仍然很重要。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估 RSV 预防策略(特别是 尼塞韦单抗 和母体 RSV 疫苗接种)在减少美国婴儿在第一个 RSV 季节期间与 RSV 相关的急诊室就诊和住院治疗方面的有效性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用来自 5 个医疗保健系统的电子健康记录数据来分析 2024 年 10 月 1 日至 2025 年 3 月 31 日期间第一个 RSV 季节婴儿中的 RSV 类疾病病例。尼塞韦单抗 分析包括 3531 例急诊就诊和 470 例住院治疗,以及孕产妇 RSV 疫苗 分析的 810 例急诊就诊和 187 例住院治疗。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用测试阴性分析评估有效性,根据免疫状态比较 RSV 阳性和 RSV 阴性情况。逻辑回归模型根据年龄、种族和民族、性别、日历日和地理区域进行了调整。
analysis_zh.main_results: 尼塞韦单抗 针对 RSV 相关 ED 就诊的有效性为 62%(95% CI:54-68),针对住院治疗的有效性为 77%(95% CI:61-87)。母亲 RSV 疫苗 对抗 ED 的有效性为 49% (95% CI: 26-65),对抗住院治疗的有效性为 82% (95% CI: 54-93)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些结果解释为 尼塞韦单抗 和母体 RSV 疫苗接种 在预防婴儿第一个 RSV 季节中与 RSV 相关的 ED 遭遇和住院治疗方面的有效性的证据。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,随着接种率的增加,监测免疫有效性的重要性,并建议将额外的 RSV 预防产品用于公共卫生策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其对电子健康记录数据的依赖以及测试阴性分析中的潜在偏差而受到限制。然而,考虑到样本量大以及对关键人口和时间因素的调整,证据是强有力的。

title: Prioritizing the introduction of new vaccine in Tanzania (2026-2030): a multi-criteria decision analysis by the Tanzania immunization technical advisory group.
abstract: BACKGROUND: The growing need for availability of new vaccines, alongside constrained financial and health system resources, necessitates transparent and evidence-based prioritization. METHODS: A multi-criteria decision analysis (MCDA) approach was applied by the Tanzania Immunization Technical Advisory Group (TITAG) to prioritize new vaccine introductions for 2026-2030. The World Health Organization's New Vaccine Introduction Prioritization and Sequencing Tool (NVI-PST) was adapted to the Tanzanian context. From thirteen candidate vaccines, seven were shortlisted: hepatitis B birth dose, hepatitis B (adult), malaria, measles-mumps-rubella (MMR), meningococcal (Men5), maternal respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and typhoid conjugate vaccine (TCV). Thirteen criteria across importance (n = 9) and feasibility (n = 4) domains were applied. Evidence was compiled and vaccines were scored through a structured, participatory process. RESULTS: Hepatitis B birth dose ranked highest (combined score 1.9), followed by hepatitis B (adult) vaccine (3.0). Malaria and maternal RSV vaccines were moderate priorities (4.2), while MMR (4.4), Men5 (4.5), and TCV (5.2) ranked lowest. Key system constraints identified included limited cold chain capacity, financing uncertainties, cost of a vaccine and gaps in local epidemiological and economic data. CONCLUSION: The application of MCDA through the NVI-PST provided a transparent, systematic, and context-specific framework for prioritizing new vaccine introductions in Tanzania. The findings support phased introduction of hepatitis B vaccines while highlighting the need for strengthened surveillance, sustainable financing, and health system capacity to enable future vaccine adoption. This approach offers a practical model for other resource-constrained settings seeking to optimize immunization decision-making.

title_zh: 优先在坦桑尼亚引入新的 疫苗(2026-2030 年):坦桑尼亚免疫技术咨询小组的多标准决策分析。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: The growing need for availability of new vaccines, alongside constrained financial and health system resources, necessitates transparent and evidence-based prioritization. METHODS: A multi-criteria decision analysis (MCDA) approach was applied by the Tanzania Immunization Technical Advisory Group (TITAG) to prioritize new vaccine introductions for 2026-2030. The World Health Organization's New Vaccine Introduction Prioritization and Sequencing Tool (NVI-PST) was adapted to the Tanzanian context. From thirteen candidate vaccines, seven were shortlisted: hepatitis B birth dose, hepatitis B (adult), malaria, measles-mumps-rubella (MMR), meningococcal (Men5), maternal respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and typhoid conjugate vaccine (TCV). Thirteen criteria across importance (n = 9) and feasibility (n = 4) domains were applied. Evidence was compiled and vaccines were scored through a structured, participatory process. RESULTS: Hepatitis B birth dose ranked highest (combined score 1.9), followed by hepatitis B (adult) vaccine (3.0). Malaria and maternal RSV vaccines were moderate priorities (4.2), while MMR (4.4), Men5 (4.5), and TCV (5.2) ranked lowest. Key system constraints identified included limited cold chain capacity, financing uncertainties, cost of a vaccine and gaps in local epidemiological and economic data. CONCLUSION: The application of MCDA through the NVI-PST provided a transparent, systematic, and context-specific framework for prioritizing new vaccine introductions in Tanzania. The findings support phased introduction of hepatitis B vaccines while highlighting the need for strengthened surveillance, sustainable financing, and health system capacity to enable future vaccine adoption. This approach offers a practical model for other resource-constrained settings seeking to optimize immunization decision-making.

title: Modulation of Respiratory Diseases by the Endocannabinoid System: A Therapeutic Perspective.
abstract: Respiratory system diseases represent a major global health burden, characterized by high prevalence and significant morbidity and mortality. The respiratory tract's direct and continuous exposure to the external environment makes it particularly vulnerable to pathogens, pollutants and other injurious agents. This exposure often triggers excessive inflammatory responses and compromises the integrity of the air-blood barrier, leading to impaired gas exchange, hypoxia and respiratory failure. Therefore, modulating pulmonary inflammation and enhancing barrier function are critical therapeutic objectives. The endocannabinoid system, a ubiquitous signalling network comprising cannabinoid receptors, endogenous ligands and metabolic enzymes, has emerged as a crucial modulator of these processes. This review summarizes the role of the ECS in major respiratory diseases, including asthma, pulmonary fibrosis, respiratory syncytial virus infection and acute lung injury. The evidence highlights the therapeutic potential of targeting the ECS through strategies such as receptor-specific ligands and inhibitors of endocannabinoid-degrading enzymes. However, the context-dependent nature of ECS modulation necessitates precise intervention. Future efforts should focus on developing selective therapeutics and validating their efficacy in clinical settings, positioning the ECS as a sophisticated target for innovative respiratory disease management.

abstract_zh: 呼吸系统疾病是全球主要的健康负担,其特点是高 患病率 和显着的发病率和 死亡率。呼吸道直接且持续地暴露于外部环境,使其特别容易受到病原体、污染物和其他有害物质的侵害。这种暴露通常会引发过度的炎症反应,损害气血屏障的完整性,导致气体交换受损、缺氧和呼吸衰竭。因此,调节肺部炎症和增强屏障功能是关键的治疗目标。内源性大麻素系统是一种普遍存在的信号网络,由大麻素受体、内源性配体和代谢酶组成,已成为这些过程的关键调节剂。本综述总结了 ECS 在主要呼吸系统疾病中的作用,包括哮喘、肺纤维化、呼吸道合胞病毒 感染和急性肺损伤。证据强调了通过受体特异性配体和内源性大麻素降解酶抑制剂等策略靶向 ECS 的治疗潜力。然而,ECS 调制的上下文相关性质需要精确的干预。未来的努力应集中于开发选择性疗法并在临床环境中验证其疗效,将 ECS 定位为创新呼吸系统疾病管理的复杂目标。

title: Direct interaction between RSV polymerase L and active Rab11a mediates viral ribonucleoprotein transport to assembly sites.
abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is an enveloped, negative-sense, single-stranded RNA virus whose ribonucleoproteins (vRNPs) must be transported from cytoplasmic viral factories to the plasma membrane for efficient virion assembly. Viral vRNPs comprise genomic RNA encapsidated by nucleoprotein N and associated with the polymerase complex (L, P, and M2-1). It was previously demonstrated that newly synthesized vRNPs are transported along microtubules by hijacking Rab11a, a small GTPase involved in the regulation of recycling endosomes. In our previous study, we showed an interaction between Rab11a and vRNPs in infected cells by immunoprecipitation assays, nevertheless the molecular mechanisms underlying Rab11a viral hijacking remained unknown. Here, we provide the first comprehensive characterization of the interaction between RSV vRNPs and Rab11a using immunoprecipitation, immunofluorescence colocalization, GST pull-down assays, and biolayer interferometry. We demonstrate that the viral polymerase L is the sole vRNPs component responsible for Rab11a recognition: immunoprecipitation of L specifically co-precipitates HA-tagged Rab11a, whereas other vRNPs proteins show no interaction. In vitro binding studies confirm that L interacts directly and specifically with the active, GTP-bound form of Rab11a with sub-micromolar affinity. Domain mapping using truncated constructs reveals that this interaction requires the C-terminal methyltransferase and CTD domains of L (residues 1756-2165) and depends on Rab11a's Switch I region, known to mediate interactions with cellular Rab11a partners. Mutagenesis further highlights leucine 1860 in the L polymerase as critical for Rab11a binding. Competitive inhibition of the interaction between Rab11a and L using the minimal Rab11a-binding domain significantly impairs vRNP dynamics during infection, indicating that Rab11a-L binding is involved in the transport of vRNPs. Together, these findings establish RSV polymerase L as the key mediator of Rab11a engagement, define the molecular interface of their interaction, and reveal a potentially conserved viral strategy for genome transport. Targeting the L-Rab11a interaction could therefore be a promising strategy for the development of RSV-specific or broad-spectrum antiviral therapies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to characterize the molecular mechanism by which respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) hijacks Rab11a to transport viral ribonucleoproteins (vRNPs) to assembly sites, addressing the knowledge gap of how Rab11a viral hijacking occurs.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted using in vitro and cell-based experiments, including immunoprecipitation, immunofluorescence colocalization, GST pull-down assays, and biolayer interferometry to investigate the interaction between RSV vRNPs and Rab11a.
analysis.methods: Methods included immunoprecipitation of HA-tagged Rab11a with vRNPs components, domain mapping using truncated constructs, mutagenesis of leucine 1860 in the L polymerase, and competitive inhibition assays to assess vRNP dynamics during infection.
analysis.main_results: The viral polymerase L was identified as the sole vRNPs component responsible for Rab11a recognition, with direct and specific interaction requiring the C-terminal methyltransferase and CTD domains of L and Rab11a's Switch I region; mutagenesis of leucine 1860 impaired binding, and competitive inhibition significantly reduced vRNP transport.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings establish RSV polymerase L as the key mediator of Rab11a engagement, define the molecular interface of their interaction, and reveal a potentially conserved viral strategy for genome transport, representing the first comprehensive characterization of this interaction.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Targeting the L-Rab11a interaction could be a promising strategy for developing RSV-specific or broad-spectrum antiviral therapies, potentially improving treatment options for RSV infections.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is high due to the use of multiple complementary methods and direct experimental validation, though the study is limited to in vitro and cell-based models without in vivo validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the molecular mechanism by which respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) hijacks Rab11a to transport viral ribonucleoproteins (vRNPs) to assembly sites. The researchers demonstrate that the viral polymerase L is the sole vRNPs component responsible for Rab11a recognition, with direct and specific interaction requiring the C-terminal methyltransferase and CTD domains of L and Rab11a's Switch I region. Mutagenesis of leucine 1860 in L impaired binding, and competitive inhibition significantly reduced vRNP transport. These findings establish L as the key mediator of Rab11a engagement, define their molecular interface, and reveal a potentially conserved viral strategy for genome transport. Targeting this interaction could lead to novel RSV-specific or broad-spectrum antiviral therapies.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在表征 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 劫持 Rab11a 将病毒核糖核蛋白 (vRNP) 转运至组装位点的分子机制,从而解决 Rab11a 病毒劫持如何发生的知识空白。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用体外和基于细胞的实验进行,包括免疫沉淀、免疫荧光共定位、GST 下拉测定和生物层干涉测量法,以研究 RSV vRNP 和 Rab11a 之间的相互作用。
elements_zh.methods: 方法包括使用 vRNP 成分对 HA 标记的 Rab11a 进行免疫沉淀、使用截短构建体进行结构域定位、L 聚合酶中亮氨酸 1860 的诱变以及用于评估感染期间 vRNP 动态的竞争性抑制测定。
elements_zh.main_results: 病毒聚合酶 L 被确定为负责 Rab11a 识别的唯一 vRNP 成分,其直接且特异性的相互作用需要 L 的 C 端甲基转移酶和 CTD 结构域以及 Rab11a 的 Switch I 区域;亮氨酸 1860 的诱变损害了结合,而竞争性抑制显着减少了 vRNP 转运。

title_zh: RSV 聚合酶 L 和活性 Rab11a 之间的直接相互作用介导病毒核糖核蛋白转运至装配位点。
source_body_en: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is an enveloped, negative-sense, single-stranded RNA virus whose ribonucleoproteins (vRNPs) must be transported from cytoplasmic viral factories to the plasma membrane for efficient virion assembly. Viral vRNPs comprise genomic RNA encapsidated by nucleoprotein N and associated with the polymerase complex (L, P, and M2-1). It was previously demonstrated that newly synthesized vRNPs are transported along microtubules by hijacking Rab11a, a small GTPase involved in the regulation of recycling endosomes. In our previous study, we showed an interaction between Rab11a and vRNPs in infected cells by immunoprecipitation assays, nevertheless the molecular mechanisms underlying Rab11a viral hijacking remained unknown. Here, we provide the first comprehensive characterization of the interaction between RSV vRNPs and Rab11a using immunoprecipitation, immunofluorescence colocalization, GST pull-down assays, and biolayer interferometry. We demonstrate that the viral polymerase L is the sole vRNPs component responsible for Rab11a recognition: immunoprecipitation of L specifically co-precipitates HA-tagged Rab11a, whereas other vRNPs proteins show no interaction. In vitro binding studies confirm that L interacts directly and specifically with the active, GTP-bound form of Rab11a with sub-micromolar affinity. Domain mapping using truncated constructs reveals that this interaction requires the C-terminal methyltransferase and CTD domains of L (residues 1756-2165) and depends on Rab11a's Switch I region, known to mediate interactions with cellular Rab11a partners. Mutagenesis further highlights leucine 1860 in the L polymerase as critical for Rab11a binding. Competitive inhibition of the interaction between Rab11a and L using the minimal Rab11a-binding domain significantly impairs vRNP dynamics during infection, indicating that Rab11a-L binding is involved in the transport of vRNPs. Together, these findings establish RSV polymerase L as the key mediator of Rab11a engagement, define the molecular interface of their interaction, and reveal a potentially conserved viral strategy for genome transport. Targeting the L-Rab11a interaction could therefore be a promising strategy for the development of RSV-specific or broad-spectrum antiviral therapies.
abstract_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 是一种有包膜、负义、单链 RNA 病毒,其核糖核蛋白 (vRNP) 必须从细胞质病毒工厂转运到质膜,以实现有效的病毒粒子组装。病毒 vRNP 包含由核蛋白 N 包裹并与聚合酶复合物(L、P 和 M2-1)相关的基因组 RNA。之前的研究表明,新合成的 vRNP 通过劫持 Rab11a(一种参与内体再循环调节的小型 GTP 酶)沿着微管运输。在我们之前的研究中,我们通过免疫沉淀测定显示了受感染细胞中 Rab11a 和 vRNP 之间的相互作用,然而 Rab11a 病毒劫持的分子机制仍然未知。在这里,我们使用免疫沉淀、免疫荧光共定位、GST 下拉测定和生物层干涉测量法首次全面表征 RSV vRNP 和 Rab11a 之间的相互作用。我们证明病毒聚合酶 L 是负责 Rab11a 识别的唯一 vRNP 成分:L 的免疫沉淀特异性地共沉淀 HA 标记的 Rab11a,而其他 vRNP 蛋白则没有显示出相互作用。体外结合研究证实,L 与具有亚微摩尔亲和力的活性 GTP 结合形式的 Rab11a 直接且特异性地相互作用。使用截短结构的结构域作图表明,这种相互作用需要 L 的 C 端甲基转移酶和 CTD 结构域(残基 1756-2165),并且依赖于 Rab11a 的 Switch I 区域,该区域已知可介导与细胞 Rab11a 伴侣的相互作用。诱变进一步强调 L 聚合酶中的亮氨酸 1860 对于 Rab11a 结合至关重要。使用最小的 Rab11a 结合结构域竞争性抑制 Rab11a 和 L 之间的相互作用会显着损害感染期间的 vRNP 动态,表明 Rab11a-L 结合参与 vRNP 的转运。总之,这些发现确立了 RSV 聚合酶 L 作为 Rab11a 参与的关键介体,定义了它们相互作用的分子界面,并揭示了 基因组 运输的潜在保守病毒策略。因此,针对 L-Rab11a 相互作用可能是开发 RSV 特异性或广谱 抗病毒药物 疗法的有前途的策略。

title: Post-Infectious Syndromes in the Post-Pandemic Phase Among the German General Population.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Persistent symptoms after a respiratory infection can impair daily life, as has been shown, for example, for "long COVID." In this study, we determined the frequency and impact of symptoms that persisted for 12 weeks or more after a respiratory infection. A further endpoint was health care utilization for such symptoms in the general population. METHODS: A cross-sectional study was conducted within the population-based digital cohort DigiHero in Germany (DRKS00025600). 39.3% of invited participants responded by completing an online questionnaire. 46 915 adults were included in the analysis. Participants were asked about symptoms that persisted 12 weeks or longer after a respiratory infection between September 2024 and August 2025. RESULTS: 48.3% of participants (95% confidence interval: [47.9; 48.8]) reported having had at least one respiratory infection during the study period. Among them, 18.8% [18.3; 19.3] stated that they still had symptoms 12 weeks or more afterward. The frequency of persistent symptoms was higher in older persons (13.1% for ages 20 to 29, 21.4% for ages 60 to 69). Most (86.8%) of those affected reported at least moderate functional impairment, and 57.9% consulted a physician. The pathogen causing the original infection was known for 24.3% of those reporting persistent symptoms: there were 483 cases of SARS-CoV-2 infection, 102 of influenza, and 36 of RSV. The symptom duration, functional impairment, and symptom pattern were similar after infection with SARS-CoV-2 and influenza. The most common symptoms in all pathogen groups were impaired physical performance, shortness of breath, rapid exhaustion, and fatigue. CONCLUSIONS: Persistent symptoms after respiratory infections are common and similar across pathogens in frequency and severity.

title_zh: 德国普通人群大流行后阶段的感染后综合症。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Persistent symptoms after a respiratory infection can impair daily life, as has been shown, for example, for "long COVID." In this study, we determined the frequency and impact of symptoms that persisted for 12 weeks or more after a respiratory infection. A further endpoint was health care utilization for such symptoms in the general population. METHODS: A cross-sectional study was conducted within the population-based digital cohort DigiHero in Germany (DRKS00025600). 39.3% of invited participants responded by completing an online questionnaire. 46 915 adults were included in the analysis. Participants were asked about symptoms that persisted 12 weeks or longer after a respiratory infection between September 2024 and August 2025. RESULTS: 48.3% of participants (95% confidence interval: [47.9; 48.8]) reported having had at least one respiratory infection during the study period. Among them, 18.8% [18.3; 19.3] stated that they still had symptoms 12 weeks or more afterward. The frequency of persistent symptoms was higher in older persons (13.1% for ages 20 to 29, 21.4% for ages 60 to 69). Most (86.8%) of those affected reported at least moderate functional impairment, and 57.9% consulted a physician. The pathogen causing the original infection was known for 24.3% of those reporting persistent symptoms: there were 483 cases of SARS-CoV-2 infection, 102 of influenza, and 36 of RSV. The symptom duration, functional impairment, and symptom pattern were similar after infection with SARS-CoV-2 and influenza. The most common symptoms in all pathogen groups were impaired physical performance, shortness of breath, rapid exhaustion, and fatigue. CONCLUSIONS: Persistent symptoms after respiratory infections are common and similar across pathogens in frequency and severity.

title: Respiratory Viral Burden and Healthcare Utilization Among Pediatric Patients With Acute Respiratory Viral Infections in a Tertiary Care Center.
abstract: ABSTRACT Background Respiratory viral infections, particularly Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) and influenza, are major causes of pediatric morbidity, hospitalization, and healthcare strain during winter seasons. This study aims to evaluate the clinical and epidemiological burden of RSV and influenza in pediatric patients and assess associated healthcare resource utilization. Methods This retrospective cohort study analyzed 1428 patients of all ages, including a pediatric subgroup (0–14 years) who presented to an emergency department in a tertiary care center in Saudi Arabia between October 2024 and March 2025. Viral pathogens were detected using a rapid antigen test detecting SARS‐CoV‐2, influenza A/B, RSV, and adenovirus. Descriptive epidemiological analysis was performed to assess clinical trends and healthcare utilization. Results A total of 1428 patients were tested, of whom 257 (18%) confirmed positive for respiratory viruses. The pediatric group ( n = 158) had a mean age of 3.2 years and was largely composed of young children, with 48% under 2 years and 76% under 5. RSV (37%) and Influenza A (36%) predominated, followed by Influenza B (14%), SARS‐CoV‐2 (7.0%), and Adenovirus (5.1%). Peak positivity occurred in January (34% of detected cases) with continued detections into March (15%). Most children (60%) were discharged, while 31% required hospitalization; ICU admissions were infrequent. Oxygen therapy was required in 12% ( n = 19), and antiviral therapy (oseltamivir) was administered in 7 patients. Advanced respiratory support included high‐flow nasal cannula (HFNC; n = 11) and non‐invasive ventilation (continuous positive airway pressure [CPAP] and bilevel positive airway pressure [BiPAP]; n = 12), highlighting substantial healthcare demands. Conclusion This study shows a substantial winter burden from RSV and influenza in young children, leading to high emergency visits, admissions, and respiratory support use. Increased medication demand highlights the need for proactive planning, resource allocation, and preventive strategies to manage seasonal healthcare pressures effectively.

title_zh: 三级护理中心急性呼吸道病毒感染儿科患者的呼吸道病毒负担和医疗保健利用情况。
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Background Respiratory viral infections, particularly Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) and influenza, are major causes of pediatric morbidity, hospitalization, and healthcare strain during winter seasons. This study aims to evaluate the clinical and epidemiological burden of RSV and influenza in pediatric patients and assess associated healthcare resource utilization. Methods This retrospective cohort study analyzed 1428 patients of all ages, including a pediatric subgroup (0–14 years) who presented to an emergency department in a tertiary care center in Saudi Arabia between October 2024 and March 2025. Viral pathogens were detected using a rapid antigen test detecting SARS‐CoV‐2, influenza A/B, RSV, and adenovirus. Descriptive epidemiological analysis was performed to assess clinical trends and healthcare utilization. Results A total of 1428 patients were tested, of whom 257 (18%) confirmed positive for respiratory viruses. The pediatric group ( n = 158) had a mean age of 3.2 years and was largely composed of young children, with 48% under 2 years and 76% under 5. RSV (37%) and Influenza A (36%) predominated, followed by Influenza B (14%), SARS‐CoV‐2 (7.0%), and Adenovirus (5.1%). Peak positivity occurred in January (34% of detected cases) with continued detections into March (15%). Most children (60%) were discharged, while 31% required hospitalization; ICU admissions were infrequent. Oxygen therapy was required in 12% ( n = 19), and antiviral therapy (oseltamivir) was administered in 7 patients. Advanced respiratory support included high‐flow nasal cannula (HFNC; n = 11) and non‐invasive ventilation (continuous positive airway pressure [CPAP] and bilevel positive airway pressure [BiPAP]; n = 12), highlighting substantial healthcare demands. Conclusion This study shows a substantial winter burden from RSV and influenza in young children, leading to high emergency visits, admissions, and respiratory support use. Increased medication demand highlights the need for proactive planning, resource allocation, and preventive strategies to manage seasonal healthcare pressures effectively.

title: Actin-dependent regulation of RSV F-mediated cell-cell fusion revealed by visualizing its spatiotemporal dynamics.
abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) induces pathogenic syncytia via its fusion (F) protein, yet how it orchestrates fusion within the crowded plasma membrane remains unclear. By integrating live-cell and dSTORM imaging, we visualized the spatiotemporal dynamics of RSV F from secretion to membrane assembly. We show that RSV F efficiently traffics to the plasma membrane and triggers F-actin-enriched protrusions that facilitate fusion, depending on branched actin remodeling. Super-resolution imaging further reveals that RSV F reorganizes from nanoscale clusters into near-continuous ribbon-like nanodomains at cell-cell contacts, forming a stable fusion platform. This work directly visualizes the actin-driven nanoscale assembly of a viral fusogen, defining a key mechanism in RSV pathogenesis and revealing a nanoscale target for antiviral intervention, thereby underscoring the power of advanced nanoscopy to unravel complex host-pathogen interactions at the molecular level.

title_zh: 通过观察其时空动态揭示了 RSV F 介导的细胞融合的肌动蛋白依赖性调节。
source_body_en: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) induces pathogenic syncytia via its fusion (F) protein, yet how it orchestrates fusion within the crowded plasma membrane remains unclear. By integrating live-cell and dSTORM imaging, we visualized the spatiotemporal dynamics of RSV F from secretion to membrane assembly. We show that RSV F efficiently traffics to the plasma membrane and triggers F-actin-enriched protrusions that facilitate fusion, depending on branched actin remodeling. Super-resolution imaging further reveals that RSV F reorganizes from nanoscale clusters into near-continuous ribbon-like nanodomains at cell-cell contacts, forming a stable fusion platform. This work directly visualizes the actin-driven nanoscale assembly of a viral fusogen, defining a key mechanism in RSV pathogenesis and revealing a nanoscale target for antiviral intervention, thereby underscoring the power of advanced nanoscopy to unravel complex host-pathogen interactions at the molecular level.

title: Integrated Hospital, Emergency Department, and Community Surveillance for Respiratory Viruses in Milan, Italy.
abstract: Respiratory virus circulation may vary across healthcare settings and age groups, potentially limiting the interpretability of surveillance based on a single source. In Milan, Italy, established community- and emergency department-based systems coexist with hospital laboratory testing, but hospital ward-level data are not routinely integrated. The aims of this study were to describe respiratory viruses' epidemiology and assess whether ward-based surveillance complements community and ED surveillance. We analyzed molecular test results from respiratory samples collected from January 1, 2024 (W1/2024) to October 12, 2025 (W41/2025) in community, ED, and hospital ward settings. Viruses included influenza A (IAV), influenza B (IBV), RSV, and SARS-CoV-2 (with extended panels in a subset). Among 8029 samples, overall positivity for ≥ 1 virus was 46.8%, highest in ED (51.1%) and community (50.5%) and lower in wards (36.7%) (p < 0.001). During 2024-2025, IAV was first detected in wards (W33/2024) and peaked earlier in wards (W2/2025) than community (W3/2025) and ED (W4/2025). IBV was first detected in ED (W36/2024) and peaked in ED (W5/2025), community (W7/2025), and wards (W8/2025). RSV reappeared first in community (W37/2024) and peaked in community/ED (W50/2024) and later in wards (W2/2025). Respiratory virus positivity and descriptive peak timing differed across healthcare settings and age groups. Ward-based surveillance provided complementary information for hospitalized and older populations, but it was not consistently earlier or superior to community or ED surveillance. Integrated, multi-setting surveillance can improve situational awareness when interpreted alongside differences in tested populations, testing indications, and clinical outcome availability.
authors: Milan Respiratory Viruses Surveillance Working Group

analysis.research_question_and_background: Respiratory virus circulation patterns across healthcare settings and age groups may be incompletely captured by single-source surveillance, creating interpretability gaps for public health action.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study integrated molecular test results from respiratory samples collected in Milan, Italy, from January 1, 2024, to October 12, 2025, across community, emergency department (ED), and hospital ward settings.
analysis.methods: Samples were tested for respiratory viruses including influenza A, influenza B, RSV, and SARS-CoV-2, with extended panels used in a subset of cases.
analysis.main_results: Overall virus positivity was 46.8% among 8029 samples, highest in ED (51.1%) and community (50.5%) and lower in wards (36.7%) (p < 0.001). RSV reappeared first in the community (week 37/2024) and peaked in community/ED (week 50/2024) before wards (week 2/2025).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Ward-based surveillance provided complementary information for hospitalized and older populations but was not consistently earlier or superior to community or ED surveillance in detecting RSV circulation.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Integrated, multi-setting surveillance can enhance situational awareness for RSV by accounting for differences in tested populations, testing indications, and clinical outcome availability across settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on routine surveillance data without standardized testing indications or outcome linkage, which may affect comparability and generalizability of findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study integrated respiratory virus surveillance data from community, emergency department, and hospital ward settings in Milan, Italy, from January 2024 to October 2025 to assess whether ward-based surveillance complements existing systems. Among 8029 samples, overall virus positivity was 46.8%, with higher rates in ED and community settings than wards. RSV circulation showed distinct timing across settings, reappearing first in the community and peaking earlier in community/ED than wards. Ward-based surveillance provided additional insights for hospitalized and older populations but did not consistently detect RSV circulation earlier than other settings. The authors conclude that integrated, multi-setting surveillance improves situational awareness when differences in populations tested and testing indications are considered.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 单一来源的 监测 可能无法完全捕获跨医疗机构和年龄组的呼吸道病毒传播模式,从而为公共卫生行动造成可解释性差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究整合了 2024 年 1 月 1 日至 2025 年 10 月 12 日在意大利米兰社区、急诊室 (ED) 和医院病房收集的呼吸道样本的分子检测结果。
elements_zh.methods: 对样本进行了呼吸道病毒检测,包括甲型流感、乙型流感、RSV 和 SARS-CoV-2,并在部分病例中使用了扩展检测组。
elements_zh.main_results: 8029 个样本中总体病毒阳性率为 46.8%,急诊科 (51.1%) 和社区 (50.5%) 最高,病房较低 (36.7%) (p < 0.001)。RSV 首先在社区中再次出现(第 37/2024 周),并在病房(第 2/2025 周)之前在社区/急诊室(第 50/2024 周)达到顶峰。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 病房 监测 为住院和老年人群提供了补充信息,但在检测 RSV 循环方面并不总是早于或优于社区或 ED 监测。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Respiratory virus circulation patterns across healthcare settings and age groups may be incompletely captured by single-source surveillance, creating interpretability gaps for public health action.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study integrated molecular test results from respiratory samples collected in Milan, Italy, from January 1, 2024, to October 12, 2025, across community, emergency department (ED), and hospital ward settings.
analysis_en.methods: Samples were tested for respiratory viruses including influenza A, influenza B, RSV, and SARS-CoV-2, with extended panels used in a subset of cases.
analysis_en.main_results: Overall virus positivity was 46.8% among 8029 samples, highest in ED (51.1%) and community (50.5%) and lower in wards (36.7%) (p < 0.001). RSV reappeared first in the community (week 37/2024) and peaked in community/ED (week 50/2024) before wards (week 2/2025).
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: Ward-based surveillance provided complementary information for hospitalized and older populations but was not consistently earlier or superior to community or ED surveillance in detecting RSV circulation.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Integrated, multi-setting surveillance can enhance situational awareness for RSV by accounting for differences in tested populations, testing indications, and clinical outcome availability across settings.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on routine surveillance data without standardized testing indications or outcome linkage, which may affect comparability and generalizability of findings.

title_zh: 意大利米兰的呼吸道病毒综合医院、急诊科和社区 监测。
source_body_en: Respiratory virus circulation may vary across healthcare settings and age groups, potentially limiting the interpretability of surveillance based on a single source. In Milan, Italy, established community- and emergency department-based systems coexist with hospital laboratory testing, but hospital ward-level data are not routinely integrated. The aims of this study were to describe respiratory viruses' epidemiology and assess whether ward-based surveillance complements community and ED surveillance. We analyzed molecular test results from respiratory samples collected from January 1, 2024 (W1/2024) to October 12, 2025 (W41/2025) in community, ED, and hospital ward settings. Viruses included influenza A (IAV), influenza B (IBV), RSV, and SARS-CoV-2 (with extended panels in a subset). Among 8029 samples, overall positivity for ≥ 1 virus was 46.8%, highest in ED (51.1%) and community (50.5%) and lower in wards (36.7%) (p < 0.001). During 2024-2025, IAV was first detected in wards (W33/2024) and peaked earlier in wards (W2/2025) than community (W3/2025) and ED (W4/2025). IBV was first detected in ED (W36/2024) and peaked in ED (W5/2025), community (W7/2025), and wards (W8/2025). RSV reappeared first in community (W37/2024) and peaked in community/ED (W50/2024) and later in wards (W2/2025). Respiratory virus positivity and descriptive peak timing differed across healthcare settings and age groups. Ward-based surveillance provided complementary information for hospitalized and older populations, but it was not consistently earlier or superior to community or ED surveillance. Integrated, multi-setting surveillance can improve situational awareness when interpreted alongside differences in tested populations, testing indications, and clinical outcome availability.
abstract_zh: 呼吸道病毒的传播可能因医疗机构和年龄组的不同而有所不同,这可能会限制基于单一来源的 监测 的解释性。在意大利米兰,已建立的基于社区和急诊科的系统与医院实验室检测并存,但医院病房级数据并未定期整合。本研究的目的是描述呼吸道病毒的 流行病学 并评估基于病房的 监测 是否与社区和 ED 监测 相补充。我们分析了 2024 年 1 月 1 日(W1/2024)至 2025 年 10 月 12 日(W41/2025)在社区、急诊室和医院病房收集的呼吸道样本的分子检测结果。病毒包括甲型流感 (IAV)、乙型流感 (IBV)、RSV 和 SARS-CoV-2(其中包含扩展组)。在 8029 个样本中,≥ 1 种病毒的总体阳性率为 46.8%,急诊科 (51.1%) 和社区 (50.5%) 最高,病房较低 (36.7%) (p < 0.001)。2024-2025年期间,IAV首先在病房(W33/2024)中检测到,并且在病房(W2/2025)中比社区(W3/2025)和急诊室(W4/2025)更早达到峰值。IBV 首次在急诊科 (W36/2024) 中检测到,并在急诊科 (W5/2025)、社区 (W7/2025) 和病房 (W8/2025) 中达到高峰。RSV 首先在社区 (W37/2024) 中重新出现,并在社区/急诊科 (W50/2024) 中达到顶峰,随后在病房 (W2/2025) 中达到顶峰。不同医疗机构和年龄组的呼吸道病毒阳性率和描述性高峰时间有所不同。以病房为基础的 监测 为住院和老年人群提供了补充信息,但它并不总是比社区或 ED 监测 早或优于。当与测试人群、测试适应症和临床结果可用性的差异一起解释时,集成的多设置 监测 可以提高态势感知。

title: RSVPreF3OA vaccine responses in kidney transplant recipients and dialysis patients versus healthy controls.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) causes severe respiratory illness in vulnerable populations, including kidney transplant recipients (KTRs) and dialysis patients (DPs). Despite the availability of RSV prefusion F protein-based vaccines, immune phenotyping of vaccine-specific B and T cells in KTRs and DPs remains limited. We hypothesized that RSVPreF3OA vaccination induces distinct immune signatures in KTRs and DPs compared with healthy controls (HCs), reflecting the impact of immunosuppression and uraemia on vaccine-induced B and T cell responses. METHODS: In this observational cohort, we analysed humoral and cellular responses following routine vaccination with the adjuvanted prefusion F protein-based RSVPreF3OA vaccine in 23 KTRs, 14 DPs and 24 HCs. Blood and saliva were collected at baseline and on days 30 and 90 post-vaccination. RSV-specific serum immunoglobulin G/immunoglobulin A, salivary antibodies and antigen-specific B and T cells were quantified by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay and spectral flow cytometry, with tetanus- and severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2-specific responses assessed in parallel. RESULTS: In KTRs, vaccination induced increases in serum and salivary antibodies, expansion of RSV-specific B cells with enrichment of a switched memory phenotype unique to RSV-specific B cells and induction of RSV-A- and RSV-B-specific T cells with effector cytokine production. These signatures resembled those observed in HCs, whereas responses in DPs were delayed and attenuated. Across cohorts, RSV-specific B and T cells showed comparable phenotypic and functional characteristics. CONCLUSIONS: This study provides detailed immunophenotyping of RSVPreF3OA vaccine responses in KTRs, DPs and HCs over 90 days, showing that RSVPreF3OA vaccination induces protective RSV responses among KTRs comparable to HCs while DPs mount modestly lower cellular and humoral responses.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated RSVPreF3OA vaccine responses in kidney transplant recipients (KTRs), dialysis patients (DPs), and healthy controls (HCs). In an observational cohort of 23 KTRs, 14 DPs, and 24 HCs, researchers analyzed humoral and cellular immune responses over 90 days post-vaccination. Results showed that KTRs developed robust immune responses comparable to HCs, with increased serum and salivary antibodies, expanded RSV-specific B cells, and induced RSV-specific T cells. In contrast, DPs exhibited delayed and attenuated responses. The study provides detailed immunophenotyping, suggesting RSVPreF3OA may be effective in KTRs but less so in DPs, who may require additional interventions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 会导致弱势群体出现严重呼吸道疾病,包括肾移植受者 (KTR) 和透析患者 (DP)。尽管基于 RSV 预融合 F 蛋白的 疫苗 可用,但 KTR 和 DP 中 疫苗 特异性 B 和 T 细胞的免疫表型仍然有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在这个观察性 队列研究 中,我们分析了 23 个 KTR、14 个 DP 和 24 个健康对照 (HC) 中按照常规 疫苗接种 和基于 F 蛋白的佐剂预融合 RSVPreF3OA 疫苗 的体液和细胞反应。
elements_zh.methods: 在基线以及 疫苗接种 后第 30 天和第 90 天收集血液和唾液。通过酶联免疫吸附测定和光谱流式细胞术对 RSV 特异性血清免疫球蛋白 G/免疫球蛋白 A、唾液抗体以及抗原特异性 B 和 T 细胞进行定量,同时评估破伤风和严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒 2 特异性反应。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 KTR 中,疫苗接种 诱导血清和唾液抗体增加,RSV 特异性 B 细胞扩增,富集 RSV 特异性 B 细胞特有的转换记忆表型,并诱导 RSV-A 和 RSV-B 特异性 T 细胞产生效应细胞因子。这些特征与 HC 中观察到的特征相似,而 DP 中的反应则延迟和减弱。在 队列研究 中,RSV 特异性 B 和 T 细胞表现出相似的表型和功能特征。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这项研究提供了 90 天内 KTR、DP 和 HC 中 RSVPreF3OA 疫苗 反应的详细免疫表型,表明 RSVPreF3OA 疫苗接种 在 KTR 中诱导与 HC 相当的保护性 RSV 反应,而 DP 的细胞和体液反应稍低。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,RSVPreF3OA 疫苗接种 可能对 KTR 有效,支持其在这一弱势群体中的使用,而 DP 可能需要额外的策略来增强 疫苗 反应。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是观察性的,样本量较小,限制了普遍性。然而,详细的免疫表型分析为 疫苗 中 疫苗 反应的差异提供了强有力的证据。

title: Unlocking the value of RSV vaccination in Japan: a return on investment analysis using an integrated actuarial-macroeconomic model
abstract: Objective Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) causes significant morbidity and mortality among older adults and individuals with chronic conditions. This study conducted a cost–benefit analysis (CBA) to evaluate the societal value of RSV vaccination with the adjuvanted RSV prefusion F protein (RSVPreF3) vaccine among older adults aged ≥60 years and high-risk adults aged 50–59 years in Japan. Methods An actuarial population projection model, combined with a full CBA framework adapted to the Japanese setting, was used to estimate costs and benefits of adjuvanted RSVPreF3 vaccination versus no vaccination over a 10-year time horizon. Deterministic sensitivity analyses were conducted to assess parameter uncertainty. Results Our results indicate that a 5-year vaccination program among older adults, including those aged 50–59 years at higher risk for severe RSV disease and those aged ≥60 years, was associated with substantial economic benefits. Among older adults aged ≥60 years, the total return on investment (ROI) was 3.3 with or without deadweight loss (DWL), with vaccination projected to avert Japanese Yen (JPY) 35,501 M in productive output loss, save JPY 1,178,403 M in direct healthcare costs, and prevent JPY 10,699,729 M in monetized quality-adjusted life-year (QALY) loss. For high-risk adults aged 50–59 years, the total ROI was 3.7 without DWL and 3.8 with DWL, with corresponding reductions of JPY 17,889 M in productive output loss, JPY 10,400 M in healthcare costs, and JPY 266,116 M in monetized QALY loss. Conclusion Overall, adjuvanted RSVPreF3 vaccination among older adults in Japan represents good value for money from a societal perspective, where vaccine acquisition and administration costs are expected to be outweighed by substantial health, productivity, and broader economic benefits.

title_zh: 释放 RSV 疫苗接种 在日本的价值:使用综合精算宏观经济模型进行投资回报分析
source_body_en: Objective Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) causes significant morbidity and mortality among older adults and individuals with chronic conditions. This study conducted a cost–benefit analysis (CBA) to evaluate the societal value of RSV vaccination with the adjuvanted RSV prefusion F protein (RSVPreF3) vaccine among older adults aged ≥60 years and high-risk adults aged 50–59 years in Japan. Methods An actuarial population projection model, combined with a full CBA framework adapted to the Japanese setting, was used to estimate costs and benefits of adjuvanted RSVPreF3 vaccination versus no vaccination over a 10-year time horizon. Deterministic sensitivity analyses were conducted to assess parameter uncertainty. Results Our results indicate that a 5-year vaccination program among older adults, including those aged 50–59 years at higher risk for severe RSV disease and those aged ≥60 years, was associated with substantial economic benefits. Among older adults aged ≥60 years, the total return on investment (ROI) was 3.3 with or without deadweight loss (DWL), with vaccination projected to avert Japanese Yen (JPY) 35,501 M in productive output loss, save JPY 1,178,403 M in direct healthcare costs, and prevent JPY 10,699,729 M in monetized quality-adjusted life-year (QALY) loss. For high-risk adults aged 50–59 years, the total ROI was 3.7 without DWL and 3.8 with DWL, with corresponding reductions of JPY 17,889 M in productive output loss, JPY 10,400 M in healthcare costs, and JPY 266,116 M in monetized QALY loss. Conclusion Overall, adjuvanted RSVPreF3 vaccination among older adults in Japan represents good value for money from a societal perspective, where vaccine acquisition and administration costs are expected to be outweighed by substantial health, productivity, and broader economic benefits.

title: Regional, altitudinal, and age-specific heterogeneity of bronchiolitis hospitalization seasonality in Ecuador, 2007–2024, and implications for RSV immunoprophylaxis timing
abstract: Background Acute bronchiolitis, mainly attributed to respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), is the leading cause of infant hospitalization for lower respiratory tract disease worldwide. Nirsevimab and maternal RSVpreF (Abrysvo) confer about 6 months of protection, so timing relative to the season affects their impact. Ecuador spans the equator from sea level to valleys above 4,000 m and is considering introducing these products, yet lacks subnational evidence on the seasonality of bronchiolitis, altitudinal patterning, or post-pandemic stability. Methods We conducted a national ecological time-series analysis of hospital discharges from the Ecuadorian Statistics Institute, 2007–2024 (19,788,097 discharges; 204 of 224 cantons had complete data and formed the analytic panel). The primary outcome was acute bronchiolitis (ICD-10 code J21) in children younger than 12 months ( n = 23,190 nationally; 22,724 in the panel), with secondary outcomes across three RSV-relevant age bands, ICD-10 code J21 under 5 years, and two RSV-specific ICD-10 codes (J12.1 and J20.5; 2018–2024). K35 (appendicitis) was a negative control. Analyses combined circular seasonality metrics with block-bootstrap confidence intervals (CIs), year-by-year disaggregation, and complementary sensitivity analyses [Moving Epidemics Method (MEM), Bai–Perron breaks, and lagged climate correlations]. Results The weighted circular peak month of infant bronchiolitis hospitalizations shifted after the pandemic in Costa (+2.16 months), Sierra (+1.22), and Amazonía (+1.91), attenuating with altitude from +2.19 months below 500 m to +0.88 at 1,500–3,000 m. Costa was stable across 2022–2024; Sierra and, more so, Amazonía varied widely year to year (Amazonía peak ranged March–July, n = 37–42/year), so the pooled estimate should be read with caution. The composite RSV-coded outcome tracked ICD-10 code J21's timing closely in Costa (0.15-month difference) and Sierra (0.40), supporting ICD-10 code J21 as a reasonable RSV proxy in both, and the three regional peaks now span 2 months. Conclusion Bronchiolitis seasonality in Ecuador changed after the pandemic, most clearly and stably in Costa; Sierra showed a transient 2022 perturbation with partial reversion by 2023–2024, and Amazonía's estimates remained unstable and underpowered. As region-tailored estimates are less stable in Sierra and Amazonía than in Costa, a single national window (nirsevimab February–April; maternal RSVpreF for pregnancies expected to deliver January–May) is a more defensible starting point, pending confirmation from further seasons and, ideally, laboratory-confirmed surveillance.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated regional, altitudinal, and age-specific heterogeneity of bronchiolitis hospitalization seasonality in Ecuador from 2007–2024 to inform RSV immunoprophylaxis timing. Using a national ecological time-series analysis of hospital discharges, the researchers found that the peak month of infant bronchiolitis hospitalizations shifted after the pandemic, with the most stable changes in Costa (+2.16 months), Sierra showing a transient perturbation (+1.22 months), and Amazonía exhibiting the most variability (+1.91 months). The composite RSV-coded outcome closely tracked ICD-10 code J21 in Costa and Sierra, supporting its use as a reasonable RSV proxy. The authors recommend a single national immunization window (nirsevimab February–April; maternal RSVpreF for pregnancies expected to deliver January–May) due to varying regional stability, with further surveillance needed for confirmation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决厄瓜多尔缺乏关于 毛细支气管炎 季节性、海拔模式和大流行后稳定性的地方证据的问题,以便为 RSV 免疫预防时机提供信息,因为急性 毛细支气管炎 主要归因于 RSV,并且是全球婴儿因下呼吸道疾病住院的主要原因。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们对厄瓜多尔统计研究所 2007 年至 2024 年的出院情况进行了全国生态时间序列分析,使用了 224 个州中具有完整记录的 204 个州的数据,重点关注 12 个月以下儿童的急性 毛细支气管炎(ICD-10 代码 J21)(全国 n = 23,190 例;小组中的 22,724 例),次要结果涵盖RSV 相关年龄范围和 RSV 特定 ICD-10 代码。
elements_zh.methods: 分析将循环季节性指标与块引导置信区间 (CI)、逐年分解和补充敏感性分析相结合,包括移动流行病方法 (MEM)、Bai-Perron 断裂和滞后气候相关性,并以 K35(阑尾炎)作为阴性对照。
elements_zh.main_results: 科斯塔(+2.16 个月)、塞拉(+1.22)和亚马逊(+1.91)的婴儿 毛细支气管炎 住院加权循环高峰月发生了变化,并随海拔而衰减;科斯塔在 2022 年至 2024 年期间保持稳定,而塞拉利昂和亚马逊表现出逐年变化,复合 RSV 编码结果密切跟踪 ICD-10 代码 J21 在科斯塔和塞拉利昂的时间。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,厄瓜多尔的 毛细支气管炎 季节性在大流行后发生了变化,其中科斯塔的变化最为明显和稳定,而塞拉显示出短暂的扰动,而亚马逊的估计仍然不稳定且动力不足,突显了 RSV 季节性的区域和海拔异质性的新颖性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,鉴于各地区估计值的稳定性不同,有待进一步季节的确认和实验室确认的 监测,尼塞韦单抗(2 月至 4 月)和母亲 RSVpreF(预计于 1 月至 5 月分娩的妊娠)的单一国家窗口是免疫预防时机的更合理的起点。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于塞拉利昂和亚马逊地区的逐年变化、亚马逊地区的估计不稳定以及需要谨慎的汇总估计等限制,证据强度中等;该研究的生态设计和对 ICD-10 代码作为 RSV 代理的依赖也存在潜在的局限性。

abstract_zh: 背景 急性 毛细支气管炎 主要由 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 引起,是全球婴儿因下呼吸道疾病住院的主要原因。尼塞韦单抗 和母体 RSVpreF (Abrysvo) 提供约 6 个月的保护,因此相对于季节的时间安排会影响其影响。厄瓜多尔横跨赤道,从海平面到海拔 4,000 m 以上的山谷,正在考虑引入这些产品,但缺乏关于 毛细支气管炎 季节性、海拔模式或大流行后稳定性的地方证据。方法 我们对厄瓜多尔统计研究所 2007 年至 2024 年出院人数进行了全国生态时间序列分析(19,788,097 人出院;224 个州中的 204 个州拥有完整数据并形成了分析小组)。主要结局是 12 个月以下儿童的急性 毛细支气管炎(ICD-10 代码 J21)(全国 n = 23,190 名;小组中的 22,724 名),次要结局是三个 RSV 相关年龄带、5 岁以下的 ICD-10 代码 J21 和两个 RSV 特异性 ICD-10 代码(J12.1 和 J20.5;J12.1 和 J20.5;2018-2024)。K35(阑尾炎)是阴性对照。将循环季节性指标与块引导置信区间 (CI)、逐年分解和补充敏感性分析相结合 [移动流行病方法 (MEM)、Bai-Perron 断裂和滞后气候相关性]。结果 科斯塔(+2.16 个月)、塞拉(+1.22)和亚马逊(+1.91)的婴儿 毛细支气管炎 住院加权循环高峰月发生变化,随海拔高度的变化从 500 m 以下的 +2.19 个月减少到 1,500-3,000 m 的 +0.88 个月。Costa 在 2022 年至 2024 年期间保持稳定;塞拉利昂,更重要的是,亚马逊每年变化很大(亚马逊峰值出现在 3 月至 7 月,n = 37-42/年),因此应谨慎阅读汇总估计值。综合 RSV 编码结果密切跟踪 ICD-10 代码 J21 在 Costa(0.15 个月差异)和 Sierra(0.40)的时间,支持 ICD-10 代码 J21 作为这两个地区合理的 RSV 代理,并且三个区域峰值现在跨越 2 个月。结论 厄瓜多尔 毛细支气管炎 季节性变化在大流行后发生变化,其中以科斯塔最为明显且稳定;Sierra 在 2022 年表现出短暂的扰动,并在 2023-2024 年部分回归,而 Amazonía 的估计仍然不稳定且动力不足。由于塞拉利昂和亚马逊地区的区域估计值不如科斯塔稳定,因此单一全国窗口(尼塞韦单抗 2 月至 4 月;预计 1 月至 5 月分娩的孕妇 RSVpreF)是一个更合理的起点,有待进一步季节的确认,最好是实验室确认的 监测。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们对厄瓜多尔统计研究所 2007 年至 2024 年的出院情况进行了全国生态时间序列分析,使用了 224 个州中具有完整记录的 204 个州的数据,重点关注 12 个月以下儿童的急性 毛细支气管炎(ICD-10 代码 J21)(全国 n = 23,190 例;小组中的 22,724 例),次要结果涵盖RSV 相关年龄范围和 RSV 特定 ICD-10 代码。
analysis_zh.methods: 分析将循环季节性指标与块引导置信区间 (CI)、逐年分解和补充敏感性分析相结合,包括移动流行病方法 (MEM)、Bai-Perron 断裂和滞后气候相关性,并以 K35(阑尾炎)作为阴性对照。
analysis_zh.main_results: 科斯塔(+2.16 个月)、塞拉(+1.22)和亚马逊(+1.91)的婴儿 毛细支气管炎 住院加权循环高峰月发生了变化,并随海拔而衰减;科斯塔在 2022 年至 2024 年期间保持稳定,而塞拉利昂和亚马逊表现出逐年变化,复合 RSV 编码结果密切跟踪 ICD-10 代码 J21 在科斯塔和塞拉利昂的时间。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,厄瓜多尔的 毛细支气管炎 季节性在大流行后发生了变化,其中科斯塔的变化最为明显和稳定,而塞拉显示出短暂的扰动,而亚马逊的估计仍然不稳定且动力不足,突显了 RSV 季节性的区域和海拔异质性的新颖性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,鉴于各地区估计值的稳定性不同,有待进一步季节的确认和实验室确认的 监测,尼塞韦单抗(2 月至 4 月)和母亲 RSVpreF(预计于 1 月至 5 月分娩的妊娠)的单一国家窗口是免疫预防时机的更合理的起点。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于塞拉利昂和亚马逊地区的逐年变化、亚马逊地区的估计不稳定以及需要谨慎的汇总估计等限制,证据强度中等;该研究的生态设计和对 ICD-10 代码作为 RSV 代理的依赖也存在潜在的局限性。

title: SMAD4–BPIFA1 Axis Governs Airway Antiviral Defense in Myhre Syndrome
abstract: Myhre syndrome is a rare autosomal-dominant disorder caused by gain-of-function (GOF) variants in SMAD4. Although it is primarily recognized as a fibrotic disease, we and others have identified respiratory infection-associated morbidity as a major clinical burden. Regardless, the epithelial-intrinsic mechanisms underlying increased viral susceptibility in Myhre syndrome remain poorly understood. Here, using patient-derived nasal airway epithelial cells (NECs) and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection as a model, we demonstrate that infection is markedly exacerbated in Myhre syndrome epithelium relative to matched healthy controls. We further show that activation of TGF-β1–SMAD4 signaling in healthy donor NECs phenocopies augmented RSV susceptibility, identifying SMAD4 signaling as a bona fide pro-viral pathway in airway epithelium. Mechanistically, we identify a significant reduction in BPIFA1 expression in Myhre syndrome NECs. BPIFA1 is a key secreted innate defense protein with antimicrobial, immunomodulatory, and emerging antiviral functions. SMAD signaling suppresses BPIFA1 expression, and its knockdown in healthy cells mimics the increased viral susceptibility, linking SMAD4 gain-of-function to impaired epithelial immunity. Therapeutically, we evaluated novel, stabilized 24-amino acid BPIFA1-derived peptides as a potential intervention. Treatment with active peptides (A4-153 and A4-X7) significantly reduced RSV infectivity and epithelial damage in both healthy and Myhre syndrome airway epithelial cultures, whereas a scrambled control peptide (A4-198) showed no significant effect. Collectively, our findings establish that GOF SMAD4 signaling enhances viral vulnerability in airway epithelium through suppression of BPIFA1-mediated antiviral defense and demonstrate that BPIFA1-derived peptide therapeutics represent a promising strategy to restore innate antiviral protection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Myhre syndrome, a rare autosomal-dominant disorder caused by gain-of-function SMAD4 variants, is primarily recognized as a fibrotic disease but carries significant respiratory infection-associated morbidity. The study addresses the knowledge gap regarding epithelial-intrinsic mechanisms underlying increased viral susceptibility in Myhre syndrome.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used patient-derived nasal airway epithelial cells (NECs) and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection as a model to compare Myhre syndrome epithelium with matched healthy controls. The research evaluated the role of TGF-β1–SMAD4 signaling and the antiviral protein BPIFA1 in airway epithelial susceptibility to RSV.
analysis.methods: The authors demonstrated RSV infection severity in Myhre syndrome NECs relative to healthy controls and showed that TGF-β1–SMAD4 activation in healthy donor NECs phenocopied augmented RSV susceptibility. Mechanistically, they linked SMAD4 gain-of-function to impaired epithelial immunity via suppression of BPIFA1 expression.
analysis.main_results: RSV infection was markedly exacerbated in Myhre syndrome epithelium compared to matched healthy controls. SMAD signaling suppressed BPIFA1 expression, and its knockdown in healthy cells increased viral susceptibility. Treatment with BPIFA1-derived peptides (A4-153 and A4-X7) significantly reduced RSV infectivity and epithelial damage, whereas a scrambled control peptide (A4-198) showed no significant effect.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings establish that gain-of-function SMAD4 signaling enhances viral vulnerability in airway epithelium by suppressing BPIFA1-mediated antiviral defense. The study demonstrates that BPIFA1-derived peptide therapeutics represent a promising strategy to restore innate antiviral protection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results suggest that targeting the SMAD4–BPIFA1 axis could inform therapeutic strategies to mitigate RSV susceptibility in individuals with Myhre syndrome. The BPIFA1-derived peptides may offer a novel approach to enhance airway antiviral defense.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on in vitro models using patient-derived NECs and RSV as a model pathogen, which may not fully recapitulate in vivo conditions. The evidence strength is moderate due to the absence of in vivo validation and small sample size.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates why individuals with Myhre syndrome, a rare genetic disorder caused by gain-of-function SMAD4 variants, exhibit increased susceptibility to respiratory infections. Using patient-derived nasal airway epithelial cells and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) as a model, the authors demonstrate that RSV infection is markedly exacerbated in Myhre syndrome epithelium compared to healthy controls. Mechanistically, they show that SMAD4 signaling suppresses the expression of BPIFA1, a key secreted innate defense protein with antiviral functions, thereby impairing epithelial immunity. Therapeutically, stabilized BPIFA1-derived peptides (A4-153 and A4-X7) significantly reduced RSV infectivity and epithelial damage in both healthy and Myhre syndrome airway epithelial cultures, whereas a scrambled control peptide showed no effect. The findings establish a causal link between SMAD4 gain-of-function, BPIFA1 suppression, and heightened viral vulnerability, and suggest BPIFA1-derived peptides as a promising strategy to restore innate antiviral protection.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: Myhre 综合征是一种由功能获得性 SMAD4 变异引起的罕见常染色体显性遗传疾病,主要被认为是一种纤维化疾病,但具有显着的呼吸道感染相关发病率。该研究解决了关于 Myhre 综合征病毒易感性增加的上皮内在机制的知识差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用患者来源的鼻气道上皮细胞 (NEC) 和 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 感染作为模型,将 Myhre 综合征上皮细胞与匹配的健康对照进行比较。该研究评估了 TGF-β1–SMAD4 信号传导和 抗病毒药物 蛋白 BPIFA1 在气道上皮对 RSV 易感性中的作用。
