title: Impact and effectiveness of Australia's 2025 hybrid RSV immunisation program: results from the PAEDS-FluCAN Network
abstract: Background Australia introduced a hybrid Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) Maternal and Infant Protection Program (RSV-MIPP) in 2025, using National Immunisation Program-funded RSV vaccine for pregnant people from 28 weeks' gestation and jurisdiction-funded nirsevimab. We estimated real-world effectiveness and assessed the impact of the RSV-MIPP program across a participating surveillance network. Methods We conducted a national, prospective test-negative case–control study at thirteen PAEDS-FluCAN network hospitals contributing paediatric RSV data. From April 2024 to November 2025, hospitalised children with RSV-associated acute respiratory infection (ARI; cases) and contemporaneous RSV-negative controls were recruited. Immunisation effectiveness was estimated using a test-negative design with multivariable regression, adjusted for prespecified covariates, and calculated as (1−adjusted odds ratio) × 100% with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Impact was assessed as the 2024–2025 change in the cumulative number of RSV hospitalisations during epidemiological weeks 14–48, excluding hospitals in two states with comprehensive 2024 nirsevimab programs, and stratified by age group. Findings Between 1 January and 30 November 2025, 3743 children were recruited (2719 RSV-positive cases; 1024 test-negative controls). Overall effectiveness against RSV-associated ARI hospitalisation in the RSV-MIPP newborn cohort (born from 17 February) was 82·6% (95% CI: 70·6, 89·7). Effectiveness estimates for maternal vaccination and nirsevimab were 81·5% (68·4, 89·2) and 89·6% (73·6, 95·9) respectively. Nirsevimab effectiveness in the catch-up cohort (born 1st October 2024–16th February 2025) was 89·6% (66·4, 96·8). The program's impact, based on a single preprogram comparison year and excluding 2 states, was associated with 43·8%, 20·1% and 8·5% reduction in hospitalisations in infants aged 0–<3 months, 3–<6 months and 6–12 months respectively. Interpretation These first southern hemisphere estimates of a hybrid RSV prevention program demonstrated high effectiveness against RSV hospitalisation over a single season. Longitudinal evaluation of the RSV-MIPP is needed to understand sustained effectiveness and year-round population level impacts. Funding This work was sponsored by the Australian Government Department of Health, Disability and Ageing and the Australian Centre for Disease Control.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 澳大利亚于 2025 年推出了混合 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 母婴保护计划 (RSV-MIPP),使用国家免疫计划资助的 RSV 疫苗(针对妊娠 28 周以上的孕妇)和司法管辖区资助的 尼塞韦单抗。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们在 13 家 PAEDS-FluCAN 网络医院进行了一项全国性前瞻性检测阴性病例对照研究,提供了儿科 RSV 数据。从2024年4月到2025年11月,招募了患有RSV相关急性呼吸道感染(ARI;病例)的住院儿童和同期RSV阴性对照。
elements_zh.methods: 使用多变量回归测试阴性设计估计免疫效果,调整预先指定的协变量,并计算为(1−调整优势比)× 100%,置信区间(CI)为 95%。影响评估为 2024 年至 2025 年流行病学第 14 至 48 周内 RSV 住院累计人数的变化,不包括两个州实施综合 2024 尼塞韦单抗 计划的医院,并按年龄组进行分层。
elements_zh.main_results: 2025年1月1日至11月30日期间,招募了3743名儿童(2719名RSV阳性病例;1024名测试阴性对照)。RSV-MIPP 新生儿 队列研究(2 月 17 日出生)针对 RSV 相关 ARI 住院治疗的总体有效性为 82·6%(95% CI:70·6、89·7)。该计划的影响基于单个预计划比较年并排除 2 个州,与 0-<3 个月、3-<6 个月和 6-12 个月婴儿的住院率分别减少 43·8%、20·1% 和 8·5% 相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些对南半球混合 RSV 预防计划的首次估计表明,在一个季节内对 RSV 住院治疗具有很高的有效性。需要对 RSV-MIPP 进行纵向评估,以了解持续的有效性和全年人口水平的影响。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持混合 RSV 免疫计划在减少婴儿住院方面的有效性,为政策制定者和公共卫生官员提供证据,以告知未来的 疫苗接种 战略和资源分配。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于预计划比较年份单一,并且排除了两个具有综合 尼塞韦单抗 计划的州,因此证据强度中等,这可能会限制普遍性。研究设计和统计方法是稳健的,但需要纵向评估来确认持续有效性。

Methods We conducted a national, prospective test-negative case–control study at thirteen PAEDS-FluCAN network hospitals contributing paediatric RSV data. From April 2024 to November 2025, hospitalised children with RSV-associated acute respiratory infection (ARI; cases) and contemporaneous RSV-negative controls were recruited. Immunisation effectiveness was estimated using a test-negative design with multivariable regression, adjusted for prespecified covariates, and calculated as (1−adjusted odds ratio) × 100% with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Impact was assessed as the 2024–2025 change in the cumulative number of RSV hospitalisations during epidemiological weeks 14–48, excluding hospitals in two states with comprehensive 2024 nirsevimab programs, and stratified by age group. Findings Between 1 January and 30 November 2025, 3743 children were recruited (2719 RSV-positive cases; 1024 test-negative controls). Overall effectiveness against RSV-associated ARI hospitalisation in the RSV-MIPP newborn cohort (born from 17 February) was 82·6% (95% CI: 70·6, 89·7). Effectiveness estimates for maternal vaccination and nirsevimab were 81·5% (68·4, 89·2) and 89·6% (73·6, 95·9) respectively. Nirsevimab effectiveness in the catch-up cohort (born 1st October 2024–16th February 2025) was 89·6% (66·4, 96·8). The program's impact, based on a single preprogram comparison year and excluding 2 states, was associated with 43·8%, 20·1% and 8·5% reduction in hospitalisations in infants aged 0–<3 months, 3–<6 months and 6–12 months respectively. Interpretation These first southern hemisphere estimates of a hybrid RSV prevention program demonstrated high effectiveness against RSV hospitalisation over a single season. Longitudinal evaluation of the RSV-MIPP is needed to understand sustained effectiveness and year-round population level impacts. Funding This work was sponsored by the Australian Government Department of Health, Disability and Ageing and the Australian Centre for Disease Control.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 澳大利亚于 2025 年推出了混合 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 母婴保护计划 (RSV-MIPP),使用国家免疫计划资助的 RSV 疫苗(针对妊娠 28 周以上的孕妇)和司法管辖区资助的 尼塞韦单抗。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们在 13 家 PAEDS-FluCAN 网络医院进行了一项全国性前瞻性检测阴性病例对照研究,提供了儿科 RSV 数据。从2024年4月到2025年11月,招募了患有RSV相关急性呼吸道感染(ARI;病例)的住院儿童和同期RSV阴性对照。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用多变量回归测试阴性设计估计免疫效果,调整预先指定的协变量,并计算为(1−调整优势比)× 100%,置信区间(CI)为 95%。影响评估为 2024 年至 2025 年流行病学第 14 至 48 周内 RSV 住院累计人数的变化,不包括两个州实施综合 2024 尼塞韦单抗 计划的医院,并按年龄组进行分层。
analysis_zh.main_results: 2025年1月1日至11月30日期间,招募了3743名儿童(2719名RSV阳性病例;1024名测试阴性对照)。RSV-MIPP 新生儿 队列研究(2 月 17 日出生)针对 RSV 相关 ARI 住院治疗的总体有效性为 82·6%(95% CI:70·6、89·7)。该计划的影响基于单个预计划比较年并排除 2 个州,与 0-<3 个月、3-<6 个月和 6-12 个月婴儿的住院率分别减少 43·8%、20·1% 和 8·5% 相关。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些对南半球混合 RSV 预防计划的首次估计表明,在一个季节内对 RSV 住院治疗具有很高的有效性。需要对 RSV-MIPP 进行纵向评估,以了解持续的有效性和全年人口水平的影响。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持混合 RSV 免疫计划在减少婴儿住院方面的有效性,为政策制定者和公共卫生官员提供证据,以告知未来的 疫苗接种 战略和资源分配。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于预计划比较年份单一,并且排除了两个具有综合 尼塞韦单抗 计划的州,因此证据强度中等,这可能会限制普遍性。研究设计和统计方法是稳健的,但需要纵向评估来确认持续有效性。
